purpose: How does tilting a two-well landscape change its resting points?
meaning: Find the real zeros of the potential derivative with a cubic formula; classify the root-count regime with 4a³−27b².

definition.setting: A toy snap mechanism has a quartic potential. One dial changes the depth of its two wells and another tilts the landscape. Watch the stationary points meet or split.
